source: Fixed lattice,kappa>0,0<=R<9/64,m=kappa*(1/2-3R),smooth real local gauge-invariant norm(U)<=delta<=m/8; actual C2-summable retained interactions, no unproved third derivatives

construction.one_form_space: B=C(X;ell2 link one-forms) in common invariant frames; comparison carrier, not a changed-state Hilbert isometry
construction.connection_limit: Synchronous original paths and fixed-link stochastic parallel transport give strong connection-semigroup convergence on B with norm<=exp(-kappa*t/2)
construction.Hessian_multiplier: M_j=kappa*Hess(V_j) is uniformly bounded by3kappa R and converges STRONGLY on B via fixed-entry C2 convergence and weighted column tails; no global operator-norm convergence assumed
construction.one_form_limit: Bounded perturbation/Dyson series gives H_j->H and H_(j,U)->H_U strongly on B, norm bounds exp(-m*t),exp(-(m-delta)*t)
construction.gradient_recovery: Dpsi_j=-integral_0^infinity exp(tE_j)H_(j,U,t)(psi_j DU)dt ->Dpsi in B; r_j->r continuously, also in the unweighted sum of block sup norms
construction.original_core: Uniform original graph-range recovery plus finite C2 approximation gives the smooth cylinder C(X) core; finite C2-coefficient resolvents need not themselves be C-infinity
construction.Banach_range: K=-2kappa*r dot D; ||K(alpha+A_C)^-1||<=sqrt(2pi*kappa/alpha)*L. For alpha=8kappa*(1+4L^2),pi<4 gives squared bound<=L^2/(1+4L^2)<1/4
construction.actual_domain: Dom(T_C)=Dom(A_C); T_C=A_C-2kappa*r dot D; smooth cylinders are the actual C(X) operator core; psi and inverse preserve Dom(A_C)
construction.all_start_points: Uniform finite-source drift recovery, point-independent increment bounds and the genuine Feller core give continuous-path laws and unique cylinder drift martingale problems for every deterministic x
construction.closed_obstruction_retained: Nonconstant-probe infinite-observation-horizon density extension remains obstructed; finite-horizon and equal-time comparisons survive

subnet.next_acceptance: Construct a common-noise strong tilted stochastic realization or isolate its regularity obstruction. Test dimension-uniform second-derivative/ell2-leaf Lipschitz estimates for r using the newly built continuous one-form semigroup and existing C2 multiplier control, without assuming third derivatives; weak martingale uniqueness alone is insufficient.

frozen_tests: 90 actual free-SU2 plaquette pointwise differentiated eigen-equations and gradient bounds
